mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing ketorolac plasma concentrations and toxicity risk, while ketorolac may increase antifungal exposure.
action: Monitor for ketorolac adverse effects (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction); consider alternative antifungal if prolonged ketorolac use required or use lowest effective ketorolac dose with short duration.
